independent.summary: The "top page" cell can still name a page the entity would never cite when the top-1 chunk is an owner-reply chunk: `retrieveContext` sets `topScore` from `relevant[0]` (which may be `source === 'owner_reply'`) but `packContext` only receives page chunks, so `sources[0]` is the best *page* chunk, scored anywhere down to the retrieval floor (0.60). With an entity threshold of 0.90, an owner-reply top score of 0.92 and a best page chunk at 0.65, the row prints hit ✅ beside that 0.65 page — the residual form of the defect LEO-117 set out to remove (evalRow cannot detect this, since it only sees one score).
